messages:
maya: Hi team, customer (MedServe) needs an on-prem vulnerability scan window + sample ISO artifacts for procurement. Can we confirm what we can share and what creds they need for the POC? cc @kevin @lauren

kevin: Quick answers: 1) We can provide a redacted ISO excerpt and SOC2 summary. 2) For on-prem scans they either run internal scans against a staging endpoint or we provide presigned SFTP/temp creds/bastion. 3) Pen-test letter — security will sign our standard attestation (see note).

lauren: I have a redacted ISO excerpt in proofpack I can pull. They asked for a 48h scan window — is that acceptable operationally?

maya: 48h is what procurement asked for, preferably weekdays. They need an allowlist of scanner IPs and short-lived creds. Who owns providing the IP list?

kevin: eng-infra owns stable egress IPs for hosted scans; for dedicated/on-prem it's usually the customer's network team. I'll check with infra. @sam can you drop the hosted scanner IPs here?

sam: Hosted scanner egress IPs: 54.23.12.45, 54.23.12.46. We can also provide a signed SSH fingerprint for a bastion if they want direct access. :white_check_mark:

lauren: For on-prem we usually ask customers to run an internal scan against staging. If they want Redwood to run it, we either: give presigned SFTP + temp user, or open a short bastion window. Which do they prefer?

maya: They prefer Redwood to run the scan. Also asked if running the scan + support is billable — need pricing clarity for procurement.

kevin: Sales/Finance note: standard POC includes basic evidence (SOC2 cert, redacted ISO). Third-party scan facilitation or extra ops time is billable. Estimate ~4 hours of ops/engineer time; I'll add a line item to the quote.

sec-bot: SECURITY: Pen-test letter template located at /compliance/templates/pen_test_letter_v2.pdf (redaction required). Any direct network access requires a completed ATO form and SSO invite.

lauren: I'll prepare the redacted ISO. For presigned S3 URL generation use: ```aws s3 presign s3://proofpacks/medserve/ISO-redacted.zip --expires-in 86400``` and share link.

maya: Timeline check — customer proposed Tuesday 09:00-11:00 PST next week for the scan. Can we meet that?

sam: We can deliver the ISO zip by tomorrow EOD. Scanner IPs above are accurate. We'll need the customer's firewall allowlist confirmed before the window.

kevin: I've added a $1,200 line for "scan facilitation & ops" to the quote. I'll attach the pen-test attestation template and the updated quote to the CRM.

maya: Great — final TODOs: 1) lauren upload redacted ISO and share presigned link; 2) sam confirm IPs in writing; 3) kevin add quote line + attach pen-test template; 4) customer to confirm firewall allowlist + accept scan window. I'll ping procurement after presign is available.

lauren: Done: uploaded and created presign link (placeholder): https://redwood-proofs.s3.amazonaws.com/medserve/ISO-redacted-presign?X (real link posted in thread). Also uploaded pen-test redline comments to the compliance folder.

sam: Confirming again: 54.23.12.45, 54.23.12.46. If they need a bastion IP we can request 54.23.12.47 as a third.

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with MedServe and close the loop. :thumbsup:
